      "title": "Tutorials are for People Who Can't Read",
      "goal": "Survive the 'Impossible' tutorial boss by exploiting a clipping error in the arena geometry.",
      "chapter_role": "hook",
      "stakes_shift": "From a confused casualty to a high-level outlier with a broken stat sheet.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Arrival in the system's death-trap tutorial.",
        "to_next": "Finding a place to hide and process the loot while the system tries to recalibrate."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 4,
        "tempo": "rush",
        "expected_scene_count": 8
      },
      "sections": [
        {
          "section_id": 1,
          "title": "Welcome to the Grinder",
          "intent": "Establish the protagonist's arrival in a lethal tutorial and their discovery of the broken arena geometry.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist reaches the threshold of the final tutorial boss arena.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 1,
              "summary": "Artie materializes in the tutorial dungeon and realizes he's in a death trap.",
              "type": "setup",
              "outcome": "Artie accepts his situation and begins moving through the dungeon.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Entrance",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Hallway",

              "location_end": "A narrow corridor lit by blue torches.",

              "transition_out_text": "Artie walks past the first set of iron torches.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["rough-hewn floor", "distant dripping sound", "wooden crate"]
            },
            {

              "summary": "Artie navigates the initial traps, noticing the world geometry feels 'soft'.",

              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Hallway",
              "location_end_label": "Tutorial Hallway",
              "location_start": "A narrow corridor lit by blue torches.",

              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",

              "hands_off_to": "1:3",

            {
              "scene_id": 3,
              "summary": "Artie reaches the boss arena doors and prepares for the encounter.",
              "type": "rising_action",
              "outcome": "Artie stands before the boss arena doors.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Tutorial Hallway",
              "location_end_label": "Boss Arena Entrance",

              "location_end": "The massive stone threshold of the arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:2",

              "hands_off_to": "1:4",

              "transition_out_anchors": ["grinding sound", "smoke", "bright light"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist reaches the threshold of the final tutorial boss arena."

        {
          "section_id": 2,
          "title": "The Clipping Point",
          "intent": "Depict the combat encounter where the protagonist exploits a corner seam to avoid damage and kill the boss.",

          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 4,
              "summary": "The Iron Sentinel awakens and attacks Artie.",
              "type": "combat",
              "outcome": "Artie realizes he cannot win a fair fight.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_BOSS_TUTORIAL"],
              "location_start_label": "Boss Arena Entrance",

              "hands_off_to": "1:5",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie dives to the left as the mace shatters the stone.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["flying debris", "dust cloud", "broken pillar"]

            {
              "scene_id": 5,

              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],

              "location_end_label": "Arena Corner",

              "location_end": "The north-east corner of the arena walls.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "engaged_combat",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:4",

              "transition_in_anchors": ["overlapping textures", "flickering shadow", "sharp corner"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:6",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie slides into the corner, bracing himself.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["cold stone", "metal scrape", "heavy breathing"]

            {
              "scene_id": 6,
              "summary": "Artie triggers the clipping error, causing the boss to fall through the floor.",
              "type": "climax",
              "outcome": "The boss falls through the floor and dies.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE", "CHAR_BOSS_TUTORIAL"],
              "location_start_label": "Arena Corner",
              "location_end_label": "Arena Corner",
              "location_start": "The north-east corner of the arena walls.",
              "location_end": "The north-east corner of the arena walls.",
              "handoff_mode": "combat_disengage",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:5",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie kicks the base of the wall as the boss lunges.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["wall seam", "boss shadow", "void light"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:7",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie watches the boss vanish into the grey nothingness.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["falling sound", "system error", "silence"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The tutorial boss dies from falling through the world geometry."
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          "section_id": 3,
          "title": "Looting the Void",
          "intent": "Show the protagonist gathering high-level drops from the glitched kill and finding the exit.",
          "end_condition": "The protagonist steps through the exit portal into the main world.",
          "scenes": [
            {
              "scene_id": 7,
              "summary": "The system glitches and drops end-game loot from the falling boss.",
              "type": "resolution",
              "outcome": "Artie acquires high-level items and a massive XP boost.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "threads": ["THREAD_GLITCH"],
              "location_start_label": "Arena Corner",
              "location_end_label": "Loot Pile",
              "location_start": "The north-east corner of the arena walls.",
              "location_end": "The center of the arena where loot has spawned.",
              "handoff_mode": "direct_continuation",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:6",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie walks back to the center of the arena where items are raining down.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["gold coins", "glowing sword", "purple crystal"],
              "hands_off_to": "1:8",
              "transition_out_text": "Artie stuffs the items into his inventory.",
              "transition_out_anchors": ["leather pouch", "inventory screen", "heavy boots"]
            },
            {
              "scene_id": 8,
              "summary": "Artie finds the exit portal and leaves the tutorial.",
              "type": "resolution",
              "outcome": "Artie leaves the tutorial.",
              "characters": ["CHAR_ARTIE"],
              "location_start_label": "Loot Pile",
              "location_end_label": "Exit Portal",
              "location_start": "The center of the arena where loot has spawned.",
              "location_end": "The shimmering portal at the far end of the arena.",
              "handoff_mode": "arrival_checkpoint",
              "constraint_state": "free",
              "consumes_outcome_from": "1:7",
              "transition_in_text": "Artie runs toward the shimmering blue portal.",
              "transition_in_anchors": ["blue portal", "swirling energy", "exit sign"],
              "end_condition_echo": "The protagonist steps through the exit portal into the main world."
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {

      "title": "Luck is a Valid Skill Tree",
      "goal": "Dump all attribute points into Luck and find a starting town that won't arrest a 'glitch' on sight.",
      "chapter_role": "setup",
      "stakes_shift": "From accidental survivor to intentional system-breaker.",
      "bridge": {
        "from_prev": "Escaping the tutorial zone with unintended rewards.",
        "to_next": "Identifying a high-value target that only a high-luck build can reach."
      },
      "pacing": {
        "intensity": 2,
        "tempo": "steady",
        "expected_scene_count": 10
      },
      "sections": [
        {

          "title": "Statistical Anomalies",

          "end_condition": "The protagonist confirms the final stat point allocation into Luck.",
